_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

junk_ratios_m1.basis: junk share of the training mix, percent, in the table's column order

arc_cot_m1.basis: ARC Challenge accuracy with chain of thought, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100, 80, 50, 20 and 0 percent junk

arc_cot_base.basis: ARC Challenge accuracy with chain of thought, Llama3 8B Instruct, Base

arc_cot_j100.basis: ARC Challenge accuracy with chain of thought, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100 percent junk

arc_cot_j80.basis: ARC Challenge accuracy with chain of thought, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 80 percent junk

arc_cot_j50.basis: ARC Challenge accuracy with chain of thought, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 50 percent junk

arc_cot_j20.basis: ARC Challenge accuracy with chain of thought, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 20 percent junk

arc_cot_j0.basis: ARC Challenge accuracy with chain of thought, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 0 percent junk

ruler_overall_m1.basis: RULER overall long context score, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100, 80, 50, 20 and 0 percent junk

ruler_overall_base.basis: RULER overall long context score, Llama3 8B Instruct, Base

ruler_overall_j100.basis: RULER overall long context score, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100 percent junk

ruler_overall_j80.basis: RULER overall long context score, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 80 percent junk

ruler_overall_j50.basis: RULER overall long context score, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 50 percent junk

ruler_overall_j20.basis: RULER overall long context score, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 20 percent junk

ruler_overall_j0.basis: RULER overall long context score, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 0 percent junk

ruler_cwe_m1.basis: RULER common word extraction, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100, 80, 50, 20 and 0 percent junk

ruler_cwe_base.basis: RULER common word extraction, Llama3 8B Instruct, Base

ruler_cwe_j100.basis: RULER common word extraction, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100 percent junk

ruler_cwe_j80.basis: RULER common word extraction, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 80 percent junk

ruler_cwe_j50.basis: RULER common word extraction, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 50 percent junk

ruler_cwe_j20.basis: RULER common word extraction, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 20 percent junk

ruler_cwe_j0.basis: RULER common word extraction, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 0 percent junk

var_tracking_m1.basis: RULER variable tracking, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100, 80, 50, 20 and 0 percent junk

var_tracking_base.basis: RULER variable tracking, Llama3 8B Instruct, Base

var_tracking_j100.basis: RULER variable tracking, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 100 percent junk

var_tracking_j80.basis: RULER variable tracking, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 80 percent junk

var_tracking_j50.basis: RULER variable tracking, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 50 percent junk

var_tracking_j20.basis: RULER variable tracking, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 20 percent junk

var_tracking_j0.basis: RULER variable tracking, Llama3 8B Instruct, M1 at 0 percent junk

posts_million.basis: million public Twitter/X posts the sets were drawn from

junk_tokens_lt.basis: junk posts are shorter than this many tokens, M1

junk_pop_gt.basis: junk posts have popularity over this, M1

control_tokens_gt.basis: control posts are longer than this many tokens, M1

control_pop_eq.basis: control posts have this popularity, M1

tokens_million.basis: million tokens each of junk and control, balanced

no_thinking_all_pct.basis: percent of failures with No Thinking across all cases, over

no_thinking_m1_pct.basis: percent of failures with No Thinking under M1 junk

it_multiple.basis: instruction data as a multiple of the junk tokens

it_from_k.basis: thousand Alpaca examples before the repair scale up

it_to_k.basis: thousand Alpaca examples after, the whole set

cpt_million.basis: million C4 tokens of clean continual pre-training, at most

gap_arc_pct.basis: absolute points the best repaired model trails Base on ARC Challenge COT

reflect_iters.basis: Ext-Reflect iterations to a baseline thought skipping rate

arc_drop_pts.basis: points ARC Challenge COT lost from 0 to 100 percent junk, to one decimal
